description: The room build only, on Windows and Linux (src/window_frame.rs, grant_caption_commands): added at setup when VITE_CLAUSEO_WINDOW=room, and tauri.conf.json does not name it, so the default build never grants it. Grants the main window the caption buttons' window commands, CAPTION_PERMISSIONS in src/window_frame.rs (docs/decisions/0015-window-frame.md): minimise, maximise or restore, close, and whether it is maximised. The Mac's own traffic lights need none of them.
